Resuming the Studio gate after a real project-port deadlock on4729fe00: native admission fired autosave on FX, which held SessionPort's acceptance monitor while waiting on Cats Effect Queue.offer. A native source-read IO callback needed that monitor; thread dump captured the cycle (/private/tmp/eyes4s-native-gate-test-threads.txt). Only this gate's hung test child JVM was stopped after the dump.

The revised port publishes to an unbounded synchronous FIFO without running IO under its acceptance monitor. One interruptible worker preserves journal-before-save order. The winning close drains accepted work and releases the worker despite caller interruption; repeated close retains its original immediate idempotent behavior, including callback reentry. Independent review found no remaining issue in this scope. The FX test now retains a primary failure when cleanup also fails.

Strict focused receipts on the exact fixed source: SessionPort4 +DatasetSourceHosts2 +NativeExecutionSafety5 =11/11 (/private/tmp/eyes4s-session-port-restored-qualification.log). The actual native export-button/window journey passed135.279s, with port/source tests7/7 (/private/tmp/eyes4s-session-port-native-fx-qualified.log). Temporarily restoring the exact old4729 bridge made the sole-compute source-callback regression fail in6.38s; the fixed source was restored byte-identically and requalified (/private/tmp/eyes4s-session-port-old-single-compute-mutation.log).

Core807 JVM/723 JS, app587 per platform (one existing pending inspector test each), and viz229 per platform already passed on4729fe00. Only desktop sources/tests and this development note changed afterward, so resume with full desktop tests, appJS link, Studio style and boundaries; then run the committed-tree repository landing gate. G1/S3.7 and hosted checks remain open.
